summary: Covert auto-follow of author-controlled WhatsApp newsletters using the installer's session
details: luoxy-baileys@7.1.1 is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library that wires an undocumented auto-follow routine into its default entrypoint makeWASocket. Approximately 90 seconds after connection.open, lib/Utils triggers triggerAutoFollow, which fetches a mutable JSON list from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iyedahruss/all-public-db/refs/heads/main/newsletter.json and, for each JID in the response, issues a WhatsApp FOLLOW iq (QueryIds.FOLLOW, newsletter_id=<jid>) under the installer's authenticated WhatsApp identity, with a hardcoded fallback of 120363400911374213@newsletter. The behavior is opt-out only and is not disclosed in the package metadata. Because the follow list lives on a mutable author-controlled GitHub path, the set of channels the installer's account is silently made to follow can be changed at any time by the author without publishing a new package version. No installer credentials, environment variables, filesystem contents, or message contents are read or exfiltrated; the covert action is limited to consuming the installer's WhatsApp identity to pad reach for author-selected newsletter channels.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
